name: Shaad Randhawa
bio: Shaad Askari Randhawa is an Indian film actor. In 2006, Shaad made his film debut with Mohit Suri's Woh Lamhe. He is the son of Indian wrestler and actor Randhawa and Malika (sister of actress Mumtaz).

credits.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
credits.overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

credits.title: Awarapan 2
credits.overview: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

credits.title: Mastiii 4
credits.overview: Three frustrated husbands seek freedom from their dull marriages. A wild idea promises escape and excitement. But what follows is anything but expected.

credits.title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
credits.overview: When Vikramaditya, a powerful politician falls  for a strong-willed superstar Adaa , their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession and pride. As emotions clash and tempers rise, Adaa makes a life-altering choice.

credits.title: Saiyaara
credits.overview: Two artistic souls find harmony through music despite their contrasting worlds. As feelings deepen, age and circumstances challenge their undeniable bond.

credits.title: Ek Villain Returns
credits.overview: When a singer goes missing amid a serial killing spree, a cabbie and a businessman's son cross paths in a twisted tale where good and evil is blurred.

credits.title: Mumbai Saga
credits.overview: The film, set in the 1980s and 90s, chronicles the transformation of Bombay to Mumbai. The story is a cat and mouse game between a deadly don, Amartya Rao, who doesn’t think twice before killing, and there’s nobody who could stop him and a cop, who is dogging his every step.

credits.title: Malang
credits.overview: Advait visits Goa where he meets Sara, a free-spirited girl who lives life unshackled. Opposites attract and all goes well until life turns upside down. Years later, Advait is on a killing spree with cops Aghase and Michael in his way.

credits.title: Marjaavaan
credits.overview: Raghu and Zoya are enjoying their lives together until a gang leader with harmful intentions turns their world upside down.

credits.title: Saand Ki Aankh
credits.overview: Following the exciting story of the world's oldest sharpshooters Chandro and Prakashi Tomar, the drama marks the directorial debut of acclaimed scriptwriter Tushar Hiranandani. The film stars Bhumi Pednekar and Taapsee Pannu.

credits.title: Hate Story IV
credits.overview: Tasha, who aspires to make it big in life, catches the eye of two womanising brothers, who promise to make her a star. Yet her hidden intentions may prove deadly for the duo.

credits.title: Raakh
credits.overview: Shattered by his wife's murder, a man sets about to get his revenge from the man who raped and killed her.

credits.title: Mastizaade
credits.overview: Two womanizing bachelors fall in love with twin sisters who run a sex addiction clinic.

credits.title: Ek Villain
credits.overview: An ex-gangster re-enters the world of violence after his wife is murdered by a serial killer.

credits.title: Aashiqui 2
credits.overview: A young woman meets a failing musician who launches her singing career, but their relationship is doomed when people assume he's with her for her fame and fortune.
